name: Proxim8
description: Proxim8 is an illustrative 24-hour distributed-inference site in an existing Campbell, California office building sharing a PG&E service with t=0 at local midnight on a business weekday, capped at 5.0 MW. It has 10 Slurm training jobs, 1,000 Kubernetes inference sessions serving Mistral and Cohere LLMs, and 10,000 short Ray agentic API calls; all use hopper_8gpu_air. The seeded workload generator uses seed 20261102. Physical sizing, workload timing, BESS sizing, office PUE, building curve and diesel placeholder are PROPOSED_HERE, illustrative assumptions rather than measured Proxim8 data. DR-2026-11-02-PROXIM8-COOLING (PROPOSED_HERE): non_gpu_load_profile_mw is building non-HVAC electricity (lighting, elevators and tenant plug loads); the existing engine cooling envelope adds modelled HVAC on top without changing alpha_max or other cooling parameters. The curve is scaled using the actual steady-state relation input + alpha_max × lagged input, so at alpha_max=0.2 its input is target/(1+alpha_max): about 0.7 MW total overnight, ramping 6:00–9:00, about 1.6 MW 13:00–17:00, and 0.8 MW by 21:00. A 1.0 MW / 2.0 MWh grid-forming BESS starts at 95% SoC and can recharge from grid headroom; no SoC-floor workaround is needed. No turbines, solar or fuel cells are configured; the diesel block is disabled. The built-in PG&E Schedule B-20 TOU rates are selected with the July calendar month; 114.82 USD/MWh is the flat operating-cost fallback.
